newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Price decline gathers pace.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Price decline gathers pace.

text.p: The recent decline in millfeed prices accelerated on Thursday, with demand unable to absorb available supplies amid fairly heavy run times particularly at mills in the northern United States, dealers said.
"There is a little bit of weekend run (millfeed) coming up that is looking for a home," one Buffalo dealer said, noting offers in that area were around $5 a ton lower on Thursday.

Dealers said strong demand for flour had helped keep run times heavy despite a slumping millfeed market. Prices in the key Kansas City market had fallen almost $20 since the end of last month with bids dropping into the upper $50s.
"I am afraid to put any sort of bid in (for Kansas City millfeed) because I will end up owning it," one dealer said.
Dealers noted that demand was seasonally slow and would probably not pick up significantly until pastures begin to dry up in July.
"Only a change in run times will make a difference (halt the current decline in prices)," one dealer said.
